STEP 1 - Vessel type: flat square plate (white, rim band visible, flat centre, no inner wall or shadow).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: square plate, medium-large, typically 20-30 cm.
b) Reference: the meat slices are roughly 10-11 cm long; the plate spans about 2.5-3 of these across the short side at the bottom edge. The plate width is roughly 2.5 x 11 cm to 3 x 11 cm, so about 27-30 cm, consistent with a standard dinner plate.
Final width: 26 cm (square, area 676 cm2).

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Cauliflower florets (boiled): cover about 50% of plate, 338 cm2. Florets stacked about 2-3 cm thick on average (mound, peak ~4 cm). Volume = 338 x 2.5 = 845 ml x 0.6 (chopped vegetable density) = 507 g. Hmm, cooked cauliflower is light and airy, so use 0.5 effective: ~420 g... I'll take 400 g.
- Tofu/fried tofu cubes (about 8 pieces, roughly 2 x 2 x 2 cm cubes, some fried): about 8 x 8 g = 65 g, with fried crumbs and seasoning ~ 80 g total.
- Meat patties/slices (three slices, grilled, roughly 7 x 4 x 1.5 cm each = ~42 cm3 each, density 1.0): about 3 x 42 g = 125 g.
- Crumbed/seasoned garnish (small amount of crumbs or sauce, trace): ~5 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: no clear base layer under the toppings; the cauliflower mound may hide a little more but it is already counted by volume.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g (as served):
- Cauliflower, boiled: ~23 kcal/100 g
- Fried tofu: ~200 kcal/100 g
- Cooked meat (beef-style patty/slice): ~220 kcal/100 g
- Garnish/crumbs: ~300 kcal/100 g

Totals: cauliflower 400 g (92 kcal), tofu 80 g (160 kcal), meat 125 g (275 kcal), garnish 5 g (15 kcal). Total approx. 610 g, ~540 kcal.
